item.title: The Global Alignment Index: Tracking Support for U.S., Chinese, and Russian Leadership
item.description: The CSIS Southeast Asia Program has developed a Global Alignment Index that scores Southeast Asian and BRICS countries on their relative alignment with the United States and China, and with the United States and Russia, in each year from 2008 to 2024.

item.title: Experts React: Progress and Setbacks at COP30
item.description: COP30 showcased noteworthy progress while exposing persistent roadblocks in global climate diplomacy. CSIS experts react to the conference’s most significant outcomes and their implications for the future of climate, energy, health, development, and the COP process at large.

item.title: Satellite Imagery Shows Tehran’s Accelerating Water Crisis
item.description: Tehran’s water crisis is rapidly worsening, as imagery analysis shows its key reservoirs fall far below typical seasonal levels amid years of sustained drought.

item.title: Understanding the Red Fort Attack in New Delhi
item.description: A devastating suicide blast near Delhi’s Red Fort exposes the persistence of cross-border terrorism, the rise of “white-collar” radicalization, and the need for constant vigilance despite years of relative calm.

item.title: CRINK in 10 Charts
item.description: China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea (CRINK) are increasingly cooperating to challenge the United States and global governance. These 10 charts showcase how China and Russia anchor CRINK cooperation and how the war in Ukraine has accelerated CRINK alignment.

item.title: The Geoeconomic Conundrum of India’s Oil Purchases
item.description: Strong macroeconomic indicators and the 2026 global oil outlook support India's transition away from Russian oil, optimizing both costs and energy security.

item.title: Schadenfreude
item.description: This week, Bill Reinsch analyzes tariff exemptions and the growing attempts to circumvent them, arguing that the Trump administration’s trade policy is showing signs of unraveling.

item.title: A Review of Energy Manufacturing-Related Legislation Introduced by the 119th Congress
item.description: The 119th Congress has introduced a series of targeted legislation that together reveal how U.S. lawmakers are proposing to use industrial policy to strengthen manufacturing, supply chains, and national competitiveness.
